Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Welcome to ROAM. We offer two distinct paths to help you find your ideal case.
First, you can design your own piece completely from scratch. In just three easy steps, you choose your size and features, select your front and back shell colors, and customize the trim elements—from the wheels and handles to the zipper and binding. Every custom case also includes a complimentary monogram.
Alternatively, you can explore our Designer Collection, which features a curated edit of timeless colorways developed by our creative team.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
To use your ROAM case properly from day one, start by setting your TSA combination lock. The factory code is 000. Press the reset button with a paper clip until it clicks, turn the dials to your chosen code, and slide the lock button toward the dials to permanently store it.
